messages.text: Plaza de Olavide is one of Madrid's most sought-after squares: a lively, tree-lined plaza with steady foot traffic and strong appeal in a prime central neighborhood. I'm offering it at 98 P, which reflects that quality. I'm happy to hear your reasoning.}

I've come down to 95 P as a gesture of good faith, but your offer is still far from the value of a prime central plaza with constant footfall and lasting appeal. I'll need a real step up from you before I can move further.
